name: Item Counter
description:
Converts any sign board into an active real-time farm item counter by typing 'counter'.
• Measures items moving strictly in front of the sign face along water & ice streams.
• Movable on-screen Live Watch sidebar with items/min speed & farm value calculations.
• Features 3D floating holograms, multi-key keybinds, and coordinate privacy protection.
• Exclusively for Minecraft 26.x.
